application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use - offices to dwellinghouses
description: Prior notification for the change of use of the existing premises from offices (B1a use) to provide 233 self-contained residential flats (C3 use) with associated parking facilitates
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The development hereby permitted shall be completed before the expiration of three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposals shall be implemented in accordance with the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - 3.	No residential unit shall be occupied until a car parking scheme that includes blue badge spaces and a minimum of 20 percent of spaces for electric vehicles with an additional 20 percent passive provision for electric vehicles in the future, as well as physical measures to restrict the maximum number of parking spaces available to occupants equivalent to a ratio of 0.71 spaces per residential unit, has been implemented in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The car parking facilities and the measures to restrict the maximum number of parking spaces available to occupants shall thereafter be retained.

Condition : 4 - 4.	No residential unit shall be occupied until the bicycle parking facilities (including enclosure details) have been provided in accordance with details and a specification submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The bicycle parking facilities shall thereafter be kept available for the parking of bicyles.

Condition : 5 - 5.	No residential unit shall be occupied until a Travel Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Travel Plan shall be devised in accordance with the most recent Transport for London (TfL) guidance. The development shall thereafter be implemented in accordance with the approved Travel Plan.

Condition : 6 - 6.	No development shall take place until a Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All work on site shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
